events.text: The Senate of the Kingdom of Italy was created.
events.subject: self
events.object: Senate of the Kingdom of Italy
events.quote: The Senate of the Kingdom of Italy was created in 1861

events.text: The Senate was initially based at the Palazzo Madama in Turin.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Senate was initially based at the Palazzo Madama in Turin

events.text: The Senate was moved to the Palazzo Vecchio in Florence.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until 1864 when it was moved to the Palazzo Vecchio in Florence

events.text: The Senate was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1871 , it was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome
